routing.title: CPA settings
routing.hint: Global CPA settings that affect Wokey keys
routing.forceOffSub: Bare model names are registered too
routing.forceUnknownSub: CPA has not reported it yet
routing.offNotice: Wokey keys also join the shared pool of every model with the same bare name. To reach Wokey only through the prefix, set this in the CPA config (it applies to every credential with a prefix):
routing.help1: The prefix is the auth file's standard prefix field. CPA adds it to the registered model names and strips it before forwarding, so Wokey still receives the bare model ID.
routing.help2: An auth file without prefix uses the plugin's model-prefix; an empty prefix registers bare names for that key.
routing.help3: force-model-prefix is global: when it is on, every credential that has a prefix is registered only under the prefixed names.
